about: Wrong answers that point to a specific misunderstanding in pre-algebra. 'pointsTo' is the subskill to work on.

misconceptions.description: Works strictly left to right instead of multiplying and dividing first (2 + 3 × 4 = 20).
Adds before subtracting instead of going left to right (20 − 6 + 4 = 10).
Multiplies before dividing instead of going left to right (24 ÷ 4 × 2 = 3).
With negative numbers, works left to right instead of multiplying first (−2 + 3 × 4 = 4).
With negative numbers, ignores the parentheses.
Does the steps in the right order but gets the sign wrong.
Multiplies the base by the exponent (2⁴ = 8).
Thinks a number to the power 0 is 0, or the number itself (7⁰ = 0 or 7).
Mixes up (−3)² and −3²: gets the size right but the sign wrong.
Does the power after the other operations (2 + 3² = 25).
Applies the power to each number inside the parentheses ((2 + 3)² = 13).
